title: El año viejo
goal: Burn an old year, which is a doll, in the street at midnight
culture: A stuffed dummy in old clothes, sitting in a chair on the pavement all day, often dressed as somebody who annoyed everybody that year. At midnight it is burned in the middle of the street with fireworks inside it.

beats.es: (Hay un muñeco de ropa vieja sentado en una silla en la acera.)
ok: y ese es el ano viejo
beats.good: A stuffed dummy in old clothes, sat in a chair on the pavement. It is the old year, and it is very often dressed as somebody in particular.

beats.es: Ese mismo. A las doce lo quemamos.
beats.good: Quemarlo — burn it. In the middle of the street, with fireworks stuffed inside it, while the whole block watches.

beats.es: ¡Que se vaya el año viejo! ¡Que se vaya!
beats.good: Que se vaya — let it go. Everybody shouts it and every single person shouting means a different year.

beats.es: (Dan las doce. Arde el muñeco y truenan los cohetes.)
beats.good: Feliz año, not feliz año nuevo — everybody drops the nuevo. And then you hug thirty people, again.
